entry.prompt: Dark spiked tower: a tall tapering tower of rough black stone on a wide jagged buttressed base, sharp curved spikes jutting from its sides at three levels, a crown of five tall spikes at the top, narrow window slits. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism. Chunky shapes, hard edges, flat faces. One solid mass, about 3.6 m wide and 9 m tall. Isolated, no ground, no characters, no flags, no eye, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Stone: black-brown volcanic rock (#2E2826) with warm ash-grey upper faces (#6E6660) so the silhouette reads against dark ground. Spikes: dark iron (#34343A) with rust-red edges (#7A3A2C). Window slits and cracks: glowing ember orange (#E8612A). No eye, no emblem, no text or logos.
